rows.resolution_note: Sentence 1 of p001 gives the UK Biobank name with case and control counts (rule I1) and reference 28, whose entry is an exome-sequencing study of UK Biobank participants that is the source of no dictionary row and does not define an osteomyelitis GWAS; sentence 2 gives the IEU Open GWAS platform without an accession (rule C2); p003 to p007 give the name alone. No accession, release or uniquely identifying citation, and no authors' own analysis, so neither a dictionary row nor an absent dataset is named.
